import pandas as pd

def main():
    # File paths for sources
    source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_56/test_0.csv"
    source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_56/test_1.csv"
    target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_56/target_multisource_cot.csv"

    # Load Source 0
    # Schema: ['calaccess_committee_id', 'committee_name', 'calaccess_filing_id', 'date_received',
    #          'contributor_lastname', 'contributor_firstname', 'contributor_city', 'contributor_state',
    #          'contributor_zip', 'contributor_employer', 'contributor_occupation',
    #          'contributor_is_self_employed', 'amount']
    df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, dtype={
        'calaccess_committee_id': 'Int64',
        'committee_name': 'string',
        'calaccess_filing_id': 'Int64',
        'date_received': 'string',
        'contributor_lastname': 'string',
        'contributor_firstname': 'string',
        'contributor_city': 'string',
        'contributor_state': 'string',
        'contributor_zip': 'string',
        'contributor_employer': 'string',
        'contributor_occupation': 'string',
        'contributor_is_self_employed': 'boolean',
        'amount': 'float'
    })

    # Load Source 1
    # Schema: ['ocd_prop_id', 'calaccess_prop_id', 'ccdc_prop_id', 'prop_name',
    #          'ccdc_committee_id', 'calaccess_committee_id', 'committee_name', 'committee_position']
    df1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, dtype={
        'ocd_prop_id': 'string',
        'calaccess_prop_id': 'Int64',
        'ccdc_prop_id': 'Int64',
        'prop_name': 'string',
        'ccdc_committee_id': 'Int64',
        'calaccess_committee_id': 'Int64',
        'committee_name': 'string',
        'committee_position': 'string'
    })

    # Transformation plan:
    # 1. Join Source0 and Source1 on calaccess_committee_id and committee_name (exact match)
    #    - Source0 has committee_name, calaccess_committee_id
    #    - Source1 has committee_name, calaccess_committee_id
    # 2. After join, assemble the target schema columns:
    #    - From Source1: ocd_prop_id, calaccess_prop_id, ccdc_prop_id, prop_name,
    #                    ccdc_committee_id, calaccess_committee_id, committee_name_x (from Source0),
    #                    committee_position, committee_name_y (from Source1), calaccess_filing_id
    #    - From Source0: date_received, contributor_lastname, contributor_firstname,
    #                    contributor_city, contributor_state, contributor_zip,
    #                    contributor_employer, contributor_occupation,
    #                    contributor_is_self_employed, amount
    #
    # Note: committee_name_x = Source0.committee_name, committee_name_y = Source1.committee_name

    # Perform inner join on calaccess_committee_id and committee_name
    # Because committee_name is string, join on both columns to ensure exact match
    # Rename columns to avoid collision before join
    df0_renamed = df0.rename(columns={'committee_name': 'committee_name_x'})
    df1_renamed = df1.rename(columns={'committee_name': 'committee_name_y'})

    # Join keys: calaccess_committee_id and committee_name (df0: committee_name_x, df1: committee_name_y)
    merged = pd.merge(
        df0_renamed,
        df1_renamed,
        how='inner',
        left_on=['calaccess_committee_id', 'committee_name_x'],
        right_on=['calaccess_committee_id', 'committee_name_y'],
        suffixes=('_x', '_y')
    )

    # Select and reorder columns to match target schema:
    # ['ocd_prop_id': string,
    #  'calaccess_prop_id': integer,
    #  'ccdc_prop_id': integer,
    #  'prop_name': string,
    #  'ccdc_committee_id': integer,
    #  'calaccess_committee_id': integer,
    #  'committee_name_x': string,
    #  'committee_position': string,
    #  'committee_name_y': string,
    #  'calaccess_filing_id': integer,
    #  'date_received': string,
    #  'contributor_lastname': string,
    #  'contributor_firstname': string,
    #  'contributor_city': string,
    #  'contributor_state': string,
    #  'contributor_zip': string,
    #  'contributor_employer': string,
    #  'contributor_occupation': string,
    #  'contributor_is_self_employed': boolean,
    #  'amount': float]

    target_df = merged[
        [
            'ocd_prop_id',
            'calaccess_prop_id',
            'ccdc_prop_id',
            'prop_name',
            'ccdc_committee_id',
            'calaccess_committee_id',
            'committee_name_x',
            'committee_position',
            'committee_name_y',
            'calaccess_filing_id',
            'date_received',
            'contributor_lastname',
            'contributor_firstname',
            'contributor_city',
            'contributor_state',
            'contributor_zip',
            'contributor_employer',
            'contributor_occupation',
            'contributor_is_self_employed',
            'amount'
        ]
    ]

    # Ensure correct dtypes for target columns
    target_df = target_df.astype({
        'ocd_prop_id': 'string',
        'calaccess_prop_id': 'Int64',
        'ccdc_prop_id': 'Int64',
        'prop_name': 'string',
        'ccdc_committee_id': 'Int64',
        'calaccess_committee_id': 'Int64',
        'committee_name_x': 'string',
        'committee_position': 'string',
        'committee_name_y': 'string',
        'calaccess_filing_id': 'Int64',
        'date_received': 'string',
        'contributor_lastname': 'string',
        'contributor_firstname': 'string',
        'contributor_city': 'string',
        'contributor_state': 'string',
        'contributor_zip': 'string',
        'contributor_employer': 'string',
        'contributor_occupation': 'string',
        'contributor_is_self_employed': 'boolean',
        'amount': 'float'
    })

    # Write to CSV
    target_df.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
